notes.title: Empire in Decay Demo Update 3
notes.notes:
Savegames from previous versions may not work with this new build!

Here's a summary of the changes available in the latest update of the demo of Empire in Decay:

Fixed bug whereby after crowning a pawn the piece appears with cost 0 in the menus as well

New Knight vs King capture animation

New planar reflections in several levels

New water shader in some docks levels

In-game HUD redesign to match the one in the menus.

Review of prices and other tweaks for balancing.

New VFX:

Disintegration when dying/being summoned

Bishop diagonal attack

Armor break/damage

Backstab VFX

Rolling saw blades VFX

Burn, bleed, poison damage

notes.title: Empire in Decay Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
Here's a summary of the changes available in the latest update of the demo of Empire in Decay:

Improved control with the gamepad so that the whole game is now playable only with the gamepad (in Steam Deck as well).

Implemented new tips and tips screen.

Bleeding and other afflictions happen at the start of the turn.

Updated Bishop textures.

Updated new weapon for Guild Leader, as well as his respective illustration and card

Chess FontIcons and Tutorial update.

Slightly improved leader animations and fixed minor issues with them.

Added new weapon to The Guild leader.

notes.title: Empire in Decay Demo Update 1
notes.notes:
Here's a summary of the changes available in the latest update of the demo of Empire in Decay:

Added a few more tips

Added Textured Background to some Run Subscreens

Added information on stuff in cells (Ethereal Flame, Pit Trap, Frozen Cell…)

Acquire Heirlooms subscreen adjustments and flag redesign for some factions.

New portraits for most enemy units

Added options to change the screen resolution and fullscreen mode

Auto-detect user language the first time they run the game

Backup system for save files.

Fixed bug that prevented players to play cards their first game.

Added new tutorial/tip screen

Extra sounds in the menus

Minor bugfixes:

Divine Inspiration wasn’t updating the damage multiplier

Damage multiplier localization bugs

Text sizes in card panel info is now consistent

Fixed lighting for some characters in some levels

Added illustration for Drill Exercise

Fixed AO in Shields. Fixed textures in TrueFlame Pawn
